class: A detail page missing its two newest signals: employer emails fell back to a generated label and the submit policy stayed in the payload
fix: Explicit 'Employer email' history label and the decision's policy line ('Hybrid auto-submit (1 of 10 submitted today)') rendered under the verdict, so the page shows what was decided and under which rule. Documents, answers and evidence were already passed through and verified present.
prevention: New event kinds and decision keys arrive with their labels and render tests in the same change.
root_cause: The f320 policy key and f321 employer_email kind had no rendered home: the label fell back to string surgery and the policy hid in raw payload JSON.
symptom: The application's audit record did not show the new mail and policy signals even though they were recorded.
why_tests_missed: Detail tests covered the signals that existed when written; new kinds arrived without render coverage.
